## Checklist

Before submitting this feature request, please make sure:

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to make sure this feature has not already been requested.
- [ ] I have clearly described the problem this feature would solve.
- [ ] I have provided a use case.
- [ ] I have considered possible alternatives or workarounds.
- [ ] This feature fits the scope of the project.
